description: Fix API violations and enforce PRD cognitive skeleton - 11 tests currently failing in tests/test_api.cjs

userStories.title: Fix: POST /api/clients/:id/logs must reject invalid log types
userStories.description: The log type field must be one of: phone | video | wechat | ocr. Currently, any string (e.g. 'sms', 'fax') is silently accepted with 201. Add strict enum validation in server.cjs POST /api/clients/:id/logs route.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /logs with type='sms' returns 400 { error: '...' }
POST /logs with type='fax' returns 400 { error: '...' }
POST /logs with type='' (empty) returns 400
POST /logs with type='phone' still returns 201 (valid)
POST /logs with type='video' still returns 201 (valid)
POST /logs with type='wechat' still returns 201 (valid)
POST /logs with type='ocr' still returns 201 (valid)
Run: node tests/test_api.cjs - section 5 & 6 must fully pass
userStories.notes: Edit the POST /api/clients/:id/logs route in server.cjs. Add: const VALID_TYPES = ['phone','video','wechat','ocr']; if (!VALID_TYPES.includes(type)) return res.status(400).json({ error: '类型必须是以下之一: phone, video, wechat, ocr' });
